settingText: The corner of the workshop near the heavy cooling fans which are currently stationary.

dialogueInline.text: That junk you're building won't hit the orbit we need unless you stop pretending we're just hobbyists.

directionInline.text: ACTION — Lucia leans against the corrugated metal wall, her posture rigid as she slides a sleek, black-market guidance chip across the oil-slicked table toward Arvin. Arvin does not look up from his work, but his jaw tightens and he uses the back of his hand to shove the component away, causing the small device to skitter toward the edge of the workbench while his eyes remain fixed on the manual pump he is repairing. The lighting is harsh, coming from a single overhead halogen that flickers with the engine's rhythm.
SUBTEXT — Lucia is testing Arvin's moral boundaries by introducing corporate-grade weaponry components.
CAMERA / PERFORMANCE — Lucia should maintain unblinking eye contact even when Arvin refuses to look at her.
CONTINUITY — The black-market guidance chip with a glowing amber status LED.
